notes: Second operator on the existing Los Angeles catalog. No new stations added. Only in-catalog stations where Metrolink actually calls are included: Union Station (GTFS stop_id 107, catalog name 'Union Station') and Pomona North (GTFS stop_id 109, GTFS stop_name 'Pomona - North', catalog name 'Pomona North').
Pomona - Downtown (Metrolink GTFS stop_id 120) is a different Metrolink station and is NOT in the LA catalog. Not added.
IE-OC (Inland Empire–Orange County) Line does not serve Union Station or Pomona North. No IE-OC entry in this pack.

Metrolink direction group is separate from LA Metro Rail direction group on the same station board. Same shape as Brussels STIB + SNCB: one station board, two operator groups, directions not collapsed. Do not merge Metrolink chips into Metro Rail chips.
7th St/Metro Ctr is the Metro Rail hub lock (A × B × D × E). Never a Metrolink direction token. No Metrolink line calls at 7th St/Metro Ctr.

A trip terminating at the board station is not a direction chip there. Union Station is the Metrolink terminal for all six lines; only outbound departures generate chips at Union Station. Pomona North is an intermediate SB Line station; both directions appear.
Timezone America/Los_Angeles HAS DST (PDT/PST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.
Oracle 'A/B/D serve' means Metro Rail lines A, B and D, not a Metrolink service pattern. Pomona North and Union Station see the same SB Line trips. Filter by stop_id.

Redlands - University (39 SB trips) does not call at stop 107 or 109. The extension that does is one weekday trip each way to Redlands - Downtown (service_id 1146). It is a short-turn chip. Counts and route_ids are in hazard-pack.md H5.
Chip text is route_short_name + exact GTFS stop_name, joined with ' + '. route_id is the long line name (91 Line, not 91-PV Line). Westbound at Pomona North uses the catalog name Union Station.
Dropping any of the six Metrolink lines from the Union Station board is a silent board cut. Source: oracle clash report §Catalog cut.
Live wiring blocked. GTFS-RT EULA §3 bars distribution without Metrolink written consent. Status stays planned until Tim approves. Do not write provider code in lib/.
